name: Non_OpioidSubstanceAbuseDependenceAndOtherUseExcludingOverdoseAndPoisoningDisordersICD10CM
title: Non_Opioid Substance Abuse, Dependence, and Other Use [Excluding Overdose and Poisoning] (Disorders) (ICD10CM)
purpose: (Clinical Focus: This set of values contains diagnoses or problems that represent that the patient has non-opioid substance abuse, dependence, and other use regardless of the clinical presentation of the condition),(Data Element Scope: Diagnoses or problems documented in a clinical record.),(Inclusion Criteria: non-opioid substance abuse, dependence, other use),(Exclusion Criteria: overdose, poisoning, alcohol, inhalants, nicotine)
